etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English ascriben, from Old French ascrivre (“inscribe, attribute, impute”), from Latin āscrībere (“to state in writing”), equivalent to a- +‎ scribe.
senses: (transitive) To regard as arising from a specified cause or source.
(transitive) To attribute (a book, painting, or any other work of art or literature) to a writer or creator.
